name: Ice Dodo
detailed_description:
Ice Dodo is a 3D parkour game in outer space. This game is a decade old and it is finally available on Steam. With simple controls, avoid falling off the slippery ice or hitting the cones. In this game, you can press left and right to steer the player (called a dodo). Hitting up arrow will make the player jump, and hitting down arrow will make the player drift on certain parts of the map.

This game has an in-game level editor. However, it is not available on Steam right now. Anyways, Ice Dodo has around 800 levels and they are all totally unlocked except at the very start of the game. The OG cup and Dodo cup contain maps made by Seojoon Yeon, the developer, with the rest having been designed by the community. If you are a fan of Roblox or Minecraft parkour, this game is absolutely for you. But what makes Ice Dodo unique is that you can not stop the forward movement of the player. Reaction time is crucial.

Fun history of Ice Dodo: Seojoon Yeon created this game as a Chrome Extension back when he was 13 years old as a fun way for his classmates to play games during school lectures. Now it is available to play on the website and on Steam!

short_description: INSANE PARKOUR GAME IN OUTER SPACE. Using left and right arrow buttons, bring the character to the finish line. But watch out -- if you hit the cones or fall off the platform, then you must restart! All 711 maps totally unlocked!
